observed_correction.statement: The existing baseline pin correctly binds the official Qwen source but also names a community GGUF as the baseline quant candidate. That still confounds model provenance with third-party conversion/quantization provenance if compared directly against an abliterated community GGUF.

official_source.current_commit_history_observed: The upstream commit-history page exposed 851bf6e as the latest verified commit at research time.

sequence: record exact downloaded file identities and SHA-256
pin one exact llama.cpp source/build revision
convert official source to GGUF with the pinned converter
load-test converted high-precision GGUF before quantization credit
quantize the same converted bytes to Q4_K_M
only then compare the pinned abliterated/community variant
why: separates model-weight intervention from uploader/converter/quantizer variation
makes an official-vs-abliterated causal comparison reproducible
permits a later community-GGUF convenience comparison without letting convenience define baseline truth

llama_cpp_risk_register.finding: A reported hybrid-model cache regression explicitly includes Qwen3.5-4B and can cause cached tokens to be recomputed on multi-turn requests.
llama_cpp_risk_register.required_falsifier: Measure prompt tokens re-evaluated and TTFT across repeated/mutated multi-turn VoiceSessionCapsule prompts; one-turn tokens/s is insufficient.

llama_cpp_risk_register.finding: A recent qwen3_5-derived conversion report demonstrates that successful conversion and quantization do not by themselves prove a loadable artifact; tensor/block expectations can still fail at load.
llama_cpp_risk_register.required_falsifier: Require post-conversion and post-quantization load tests plus GGUF metadata/block-structure receipt before benchmark credit.

llama_cpp_risk_register.finding: Hybrid Qwen3.5 prompt-cache behavior has been reported to force full prompt reprocessing in long changing tool-oriented conversations.
llama_cpp_risk_register.required_falsifier: Include long-context tool-schema/history mutation cases because Frankenstein voice sessions are multi-turn and stateful.

counterhypothesis.statement: A reputable community Q4_K_M quant is equivalent enough that self-conversion adds work without changing the measured frontier.
counterhypothesis.test: After the self-derived official Q4_K_M passes load and benchmark gates, compare one pinned community Q4 under the exact same llama.cpp build, prompt corpus and hardware receipt.
counterhypothesis.decision_rule: If quality/latency/cache behavior and metadata are equivalent within declared tolerances, community quantization may be admitted as a deployment shortcut; it must not retroactively replace provenance-controlled baseline evidence.
